notes: Summary: regional legal-tech vendor building low-latency EU/UK internal search for litigation teams. Primary focus = embeddings + reranking pipeline to serve short interactive workflows (support lawyers, paralegals).
Scale: starting data set ~120M sentences (contract clauses + case law) -> expect to grow to 500M+ vectors over 18 months. Concerned about index size, shard strategy, and vector store TCO.
Latency & throughput targets: 95th pctl < 100ms for single-shard rerank path; p99 < 250ms for blended multi-region failover. Peak QPS target 350 qps during business hours across EU/UK offices.

Cost sensitivity: procurement team asking for cost-per-query estimate under both Dedicated and Private deployment modes. Wants model quantization recommendations to hit cost budget without harming rerank quality.
Model preferences: prefer open Llama/Redwood-verified variants; open to 8-bit quantized reranker + 16-bit generator. Requires model vetting and baseline evals on held-out legal prompts.

Routing/failover needs: must serve UK users from a UK-hosted region by default (data residency), fall back to eu-west region only on capacity failure. Requires automated multi-region routing policy and failover SLA.

Security/compliance: SSO (SAML) mandatory, audit logs for all queries, KMS integration for keys, 7-year retention controls for certain corp records. Will require SOC2/ISO27001 paperwork and a data residency attestation for the UK region.
